wallpapers.title: Ion Hunt
wallpapers.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: final ultra-wide Linux desktop wallpaper, Dark Wolfcloud theme companion, very wide 3440x1440 / 21:9 composition, edge-to-edge image.
Input image 1 is a STYLE AND MATERIAL REFERENCE ONLY: the user's existing Dark Wolfcloud wallpaper. Create a NEW original composition, not an edit or recreation of its framing. Match the reference's cinematic dark science-fantasy world, faceted black slate / obsidian wolf forms, storm cloud layers, incredibly tactile sharp rocks, glacial cyan energy, molten amber eye, restrained ember red and storm rose highlights. Sophisticated high-budget concept art, real atmosphere and dramatic scale, exceptional detail without noisy oversharpening. About 75% of the frame remains dark with deep blue-black #0b1216 / #05090c and storm steel #18262d; highlights glacial cyan #71e5e8 and amber #ffbf69. Strong readable silhouettes. No buildings, no people, no lettering, no logos, no UI, no watermark, no collage, no borders. The wallpaper must look spectacular on an ultrawide monitor and still leave calm dark areas for desktop windows. Scene: an immense spectral wolf formed from layered obsidian plates and trailing black storm cloud strides across a ravine of jagged frozen volcanic spires. A distant, lower camera shows the wolf in three-quarter profile in the right-middle distance, facing left, whole forequarters and massive shoulders visible, silhouette breaking through cyan backlit cloud. ONE small fiercely amber eye. A narrow glacial cyan lightning river winds from the lower left through the ravine toward the wolf, becoming wisps of cyan fog under its paws; tiny amber mineral embers at the river edges. Deep negative space in the upper left, layered mist and distant razor peaks across the horizon, powerful storm vortex behind the wolf but no giant bright moon. A cooler, quieter, more mysterious companion to the original, with cyan dominant and amber a precious focal point. Avoid a giant floating horizontal wolf head; this scene is a hunt across terrain, not a remake of the reference. Render as a very wide 21:9 landscape wallpaper, preferably 3440x1440.

Molten amber and ember-red fissures run from the bottom right foreground in an elegant sweeping curve toward the caldera below its chest, like a restrained luminous scar, not a whole orange lava ocean. Thin cyan storm light cuts the far-right horizon and rims the upper edges of the rock. Vast layered dark volcanic mountains and near-black sky. Warm amber is the principal accent, glacial cyan the counterpoint. Moody and premium, more mythic and grounded than the reference, with huge dark areas and exquisite material detail. Keep the bright lava to narrow concentrated accents, no daylight, no saturated orange sky, no flames obscuring the wolf. Render as a very wide 21:9 landscape wallpaper, preferably 3440x1440.
